name: manual_412331
claim: When a Markdown validator uses paragraph context to detect indented code, Setext heading underlines must end the paragraph before indentation is classified. Test code-only examples and examples beside real content for both equals and hyphen underlines, then advance every pinned consumer of the canonical checker.

decisions.notes: Oramasys review5795133654 exposed false acceptance and duplicate-table errors in the checker pinned by architecture CI. Six failing Setext subcases reproduced the issue; the corrected canonical checker passes22 CLI tests. The handoff also now explicitly orders C8 host evidence before C9/R6 review, C10/R7 promotion and C11/R8 activation. https://github.com/oramasys/oramasys/pull/94#pullrequestreview-5795133654
